Patent notice: AAC audio decoder (AAC-LC)

This optional feature installs an AAC-LC audio decoder (a Media Foundation transform built from FFmpeg's native
"aac" decoder, LGPL-2.1-or-later). It decodes AAC-LC only: the HE-AAC (SBR) and HE-AAC v2 (PS) tools are not
included, and streams that use them are refused.

AAC is covered by patents in some countries (the Via Licensing AAC patent pool). Neither NitroOS nor the FFmpeg
licence grants you a patent licence. Many of the core AAC-LC patents are reported to have expired, but whether you
need a licence depends on your country and your use. This is not legal advice: check for yourself before you turn
the feature on. It is off by default and you can turn it off again at any time (Optional Features, or
featmgr /disable aac-lc).

The licence texts and the written source offer are installed in %SystemRoot%\System32\aac-lc-licenses.
